evidence: lineage.go wraps both memorycard lookups in memory.LineageError, and the wrap happens only after the Engram listing has already succeeded. An Engram listing failure therefore still reaches sourceAnswers as a plain error and still reports unavailable.
sourceAnswers falls through to the Probe check only when errors.As finds a LineageError, so a real source failure keeps its previous behaviour.
The new unit test and the new integration test cover the changed classification. The integration test checks both the exit code and that stderr names memorycard.
